note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status, navigation icon buttons (Home, Messages, etc.), and footer links; the rooms-list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Sidebar top bar -- renders: fixed section title (e.g., 'Channels') and fixed action buttons
Sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels (e.g., 'Favorites', 'Channels')
Main content chrome -- renders: page heading, tab labels (e.g., 'Members', 'Roles'), search input, and pagination controls; the table is subtracted as it renders user-generated member data
Table header row -- renders: fixed column headers (e.g., 'Name', 'Username', 'Roles')
Pagination controls -- renders: page numbers and navigation buttons
